items.title: Add original intent snapshot and milestone ledger commands
items.context: Implement original_intent_snapshot_set/get and milestone_ledger_set/add/get as PLAN-oriented process artifacts. The minimum Intent MVP payload is sourceText, normalizedOutcome, and acceptanceClaim. Milestone ledger should be optional and triggered by multi-deliverable structural or semantic signals.

happy.desc: original_intent_snapshot_set stores sourceText, normalizedOutcome, acceptanceClaim, immutable requestHash, and keyRequirementIds; original_intent_snapshot_get reads the same artifact back.
milestone_ledger_set stores a ledger and milestone_ledger_add appends a new milestone; milestone_ledger_get returns all rows.

edge.desc: Intent MVP set rejects missing sourceText, normalizedOutcome, or acceptanceClaim.
Milestone ledger is optional for a single-outcome story and diagnostics do not require it unless triggers or provided milestones exist.

adversarial.desc: Malformed milestone refs or non-array milestone payloads fail before corrupting the artifact.
Changing sourceText produces a different requestHash, preserving immutable source-request identity.

items.userSees: User sees "original_intent_snapshot_get returns sourceText, normalizedOutcome, and acceptanceClaim; milestone_ledger_get returns the stored milestone rows."

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke covers original_intent_snapshot_set/get, requestHash derivation, keyRequirementIds, and persisted acceptanceClaim.
Smoke covers milestone_ledger_set, milestone_ledger_add, and milestone_ledger_get returning set plus appended rows.
Smoke rejects missing sourceText, normalizedOutcome, and acceptanceClaim before storing an Intent MVP artifact.
Smoke proves a clear low-risk feature stays intent_mvp and isolated complete wording does not create milestone coverage gaps.
Smoke rejects non-array milestone payloads and malformed checklistRefs before corrupting the ledger artifact.
Smoke attempts changed sourceText and verifies immutable requestHash protection.
B-7287 snapshot was stored and read back with requestHash sha256:2e14a4899562425cbaa205cf3a0ae0222be43c62bbc1faff1363ee6c212cabec.
B-7287 ledger read back 8 machine-countable milestone rows with checklist and verificationIntent refs.

items.title: Add minimal ProofStory diagnostic envelope storage
items.context: Implement proofstory_contract_set/get only as the MVP storage envelope needed by M2 dry-run diagnostics and progressive intent hardening classification. This is not full M4 gate integration, not enforce mode, and not a claim that the complete ProofStory Contract And Gate milestone is done.

happy.desc: proofstory_contract_set stores a minimal diagnostic envelope with intentHardening classification; proofstory_contract_get reads it back.

edge.desc: proofstory_contract_set derives hardening classification without adding a standalone hardening command.

adversarial.desc: The MVP contract command does not enable story_advance enforcement or claim full M4 gate integration.

items.userSees: User sees "proofstory_contract_get returns intentHardening.level plus triggerReasons and requiredArtifacts."

items.title: Add dry-run intent coverage and ProofStory gate diagnostics
items.context: Implement intent_coverage_check --dryRun and proofstory_gate_check --dryRun. They should report missing artifacts, selected hardening level, trigger reasons, and would-block diagnostics without enforcing DEV admission.

happy.desc: intent_collision_get reads an existing collision artifact or returns an empty diagnostic without implementing M3 authoring.
intent_coverage_check --dryRun reports selected hardening level, trigger reasons, uncovered milestones, and missing acceptance bindings without writing lifecycle state.

proofstory_gate_check --dryRun reports would-block diagnostics for missing MVP artifacts, missing intent collision when triggered, missing red evidence, missing spike evidence, and scope ambiguity without enforcing DEV admission.

edge.desc: A clear single-outcome standard feature is classified as Intent MVP and does not require intent collision or milestone ledger by default.
A request with explicit count or all milestones triggers milestone intent diagnostics.

adversarial.desc: Isolated keyword wording such as complete this small typo fix does not trigger milestone ledger by itself.
Dry-run diagnostics mention red/spike/scope ambiguity as diagnostic gaps only and do not create red, spike, DONE, or enforce artifacts.

items.userSees: User sees "proofstory_gate_check --dryRun reports wouldBlock and issues without advancing or enforcing lifecycle state."

items.title: Validate commands, process-fact registration, and docs alignment
items.context: Add focused tests and process-fact coverage for the new commands/artifacts. Run build and targeted validation, but do not enable global enforce behavior.

happy.desc: New commands are registered in handler registry, CLI schemas/catalog, command policy, phase allowlists, and process-fact levels/registry.
Build and focused smoke verification pass after implementation.

edge.desc: process-fact contract verification fails if a new gate-consumed artifact or command registration is missing.

adversarial.desc: No implementation adds red/spike/DONE enforce behavior or global ProofStory blocking in this story.

items.userSees: User sees "build and focused proofstory intent hardening verification passed; command and process-fact registration are covered."

items.title: Report M0-M2 milestone completion table
items.context: Maintain a user-visible milestone table for this story and mark each M0-M2 row complete only after the corresponding code/docs/tests are actually implemented and verified. This satisfies the user request to see every milestone checked off when developed.
items.userSees: User sees "M0 Documentation: [done]; M1 Intent artifacts: [done]; M2 Dry-run diagnostics: [done]" only after those rows are verified.

happy.desc: Final response includes a M0-M2 milestone table with checkmarks only for verified completed rows.

edge.desc: If a milestone is not actually implemented or verified, the final table does not mark it complete.

adversarial.desc: The final table does not imply M3-M9, red/spike, DONE enforcement, or full M4 gate work is complete.
